jackpot: The stars align, the river sings, and you found the 420. It was written.
The great tree of fortune shakes its golden branches tonight. You are the chosen leaf.
My grimoire says: when the three numbers unite, the world turns the right way.
The 420. The moon predicted it. I predicted it. We all predicted it.
You did not roll the dice—the dice chose you.
failure: Fog rarely clears with the first breath. Patience, traveler.
The enchanted forest said no tonight. But the enchanted forest may reconsider.
In stories, the hero always fails before triumphing. You are in the right chapter.
The spirits of luck are resting. They will return. They always do.
A no from the dice is only a delayed yes.
funnyCombo: This combination appears in none of my books. It exists now because of you.
Weasels have a very peculiar sense of humor. So do the dice tonight.
Magic sometimes takes... unexpected forms. That is what makes it magic.
I consult my runes... they say: ‘interesting.’ Very interesting.
Destiny has questionable taste. But it always has a reason.
tripleSymbol: The same symbol three times. The three moons are aligned tonight.
A triple! In the tradition of mystical weasels, that is a powerful sign.
The universe insists. When it repeats itself three times, you listen.
Triple symbol. The forest trembles. Gently. Joyfully.
The three guardians of the symbol bow before you.
reroll: Roll again. The river has not said its last word.
Another breath over the dice. The wind carries your wishes.
You still have a way to go through this forest. Keep going.
The dice remain open to negotiation. Take them again.
Every roll is a prayer to the gods of chance. Pray once more.
lockDie: You keep this die. It belongs to your destiny now.
Locked in the amber of magic. It will not move again.
You recognized its value. That is a sign of ancient wisdom.
The die is protected, under the spell of your intentions.
Wise decision. The weasel approves. And the weasel knows.
